message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Deploy mfa:admin and mfa:dbadmin. The first blocks authentication to DC and ADFS, so admin_dc and admin_adfs remain unreachable. The second then blocks authentication to DB, fileserver, and backup, including when CI leaks stolen_dbadmin. All exfiltration techniques therefore remain unreachable. No single control suffices: mfa:admin alone leaves the CI-secret-leak route open, while mfa:dbadmin alone can be bypassed through DC or ADFS administration. Any other single control leaves a route through phishing, internal access, stolen administrator credentials, DC or ADFS, and a data store; segmentation alone is bypassed by escalating the phished workstation or laptop."}
